title: Austin High School Bond Interest Payment Approved
summary:
• **Special Meeting Called:** The city council held an emergency meeting on July 19, 1901, specifically to vote on paying $607 in interest owed on the city's high school bonds (due July 1st).

• **Unanimous Approval:** The ordinance to appropriate funds for the bond interest passed without opposition, with 8 aldermen voting yes and none voting no.

• **Enforcement of Attendance:** The council took roll call seriously, ordering the city marshal to bring in absent members and even tracking down aldermen who were out of town by leaving notices at their homes.
